comment: coursier-paths is a multi-release jar: on JDK 22+ `coursier.paths.shaded.dirs.impl.WindowsDefault` (from META-INF/versions/22) resolves Windows known
folders with `WindowsForeign`, which links two FFM downcalls into shell32/ole32. Native image refuses unregistered downcalls at runtime with
MissingForeignRegistrationError -- the exact failure mode of #601 -- and `UserPaths.fromAppDirs` is the first thing `Main._main` runs, so an unregistered
downcall means the binary aborts before doing anything. Registration matches on descriptor shape, not symbol name.
CLSIDFromString(LPCOLESTR lpsz, LPCLSID pclsid) -> HRESULT              jint (void*, void*)
SHGetKnownFolderPath(REFKNOWNFOLDERID, DWORD, HANDLE, PWSTR*) -> HRESULT  jint (void*, jint, void*, void*)
`bleep selftest` resolves the user paths unconditionally so CI has to link these -- see Main.selftestUserPaths.
